findings.title: Slice-abort unit test only passed while other tests kept the event loop alive
findings.action: Give the hanging fake a ref'd timer the element signal releases
findings.disposition_rationale: 92147df9: the fake now holds a ref'd timer cleared on abort; passes alone and under --test-name-pattern='FAFF-1239|FAFF-885' with none cancelled.

findings.title: sleep newly exported though nothing imports it
Em dash in the new impure test header
Abort listener not unlinked on response error or premature-close paths
findings.disposition_rationale: 702fa905: both transports unlink on res 'close', and destroyOnAbort's unlink is idempotent.

findings.title: An abort during retry reclassifies a terminal fault as transport-failed
findings.action: Check terminal faults before the abort
findings.disposition_rationale: An element is aborted only when its slice is exhausted (result discarded) or after it settled (result already in hand), so an abort never changes a result the chain keeps.

findings.title: signal.reason may be undefined, giving an errorless failure record
findings.action: Coerce a missing reason to an Error
findings.disposition_rationale: Every abort call in the module passes an Error ('chain slice exhausted', 'chain element settled', 'first-byte breach'), and the result of an aborted element is discarded.

findings.title: The exit backstop may list its own timer as the leak
findings.disposition_rationale: Reproduced: with only a net server open the line reads 'leaked handle(s): TCPServerWrap', with no Timeout entry for the backstop itself.

findings.title: The pass-through adds a fifth { signal } argument to injected streamFn fakes
findings.action: Gate or document the new shape
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec's chosen design (section 6, pass-through arity): four arguments are kept byte-for-byte whenever no signal is given, and the header comment documents the signal-only fifth argument.
